chunks: And make for me a tongue of truth among the later ones

key_terms.لِسَانِ صِدْقٍ: Tongue of truth; enduring legacy or remembrance

ai.seo_question: What does 'tongue of truth' mean in Surah Ash-Shu'ara?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a divine promise for the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) to maintain an enduring, truthful legacy among subsequent generations, particularly through the Ahl al-Bayt who preserve the authentic message. It underscores the continuity of prophetic truth beyond his physical presence, ensuring that his teachings remain a 'tongue of truth' for the ummah until the Day of Judgment.
